text:
I read all 7 tracked files. The site is small and the basics are sound, but it has no structured data or business facts, and the AI-crawler policy isn't fully enforced.

## What's correct (no action)
- Every page has a unique `<title>`, meta description, canonical URL, `lang` and viewport (`index.html:6-8`, `breads.html:6-8`, `classes.html:6-8`).
- `members/index.html:9` is `noindex`, and `/members/` is left out of `sitemap.xml`.
- `robots.txt:8` points to the sitemap, and every sitemap URL matches its page's canonical URL.
- `robots.txt:5-6` blocks GPTBot, which fits `geo.config.json`, where training crawlers are blocked and AI search crawlers are allowed.
- `robots.txt:1-2` allows everything else, so search bots such as OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot and Claude-SearchBot can crawl. That matches the "allow AI search" policy.

## Problems, most important first

1. **The "block training crawlers" policy is only half enforced.** `robots.txt:5-6` blocks only GPTBot. `geo.config.json:1` says all training crawlers should be blocked, but the `User-agent: *` rule at `robots.txt:1-2` lets the others in.
   - **Fix:** add `Disallow: /` groups for the other training crawlers. These are `Google-Extended`, `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `CCBot`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Bytespider` and `Meta-ExternalAgent`.
   - Don't block `Googlebot`, `bingbot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot` or `Claude-SearchBot`, because these power search and answers.

2. **No structured data on any page.** `index.html:9` and `breads.html:9` have an empty line where JSON-LD seems to have been intended, and `classes.html:9` is the same.
   - **Fix:** add a `Bakery` (or `LocalBusiness`) JSON-LD block on `index.html` with name, URL, address, geo, opening hours, phone and image.
   - Add `ItemList` or `Product` markup on `breads.html`.
   - Add `Course` or `Event` markup on `classes.html`.
   - Add `BreadcrumbList` on the inner pages.

3. **No business facts anywhere (name, address, phone, hours, prices).** No page has a footer or contact block. Local search and AI answers can't say where the bakery is, when it's open or how to book.
   - **Fix:** add visible address, hours and contact details to the shared footer, and put the same facts in the JSON-LD from item 2.
   - On `index.html:15`, "Pre-order for weekend collection" doesn't say how to pre-order. Add a link or form.

4. **Thin content that AI engines can't quote.**
   - `breads.html:15` says "Over twenty loaves" but names only two. List every loaf with its flour or grain, flavour and price, as headings or a list. That is the content people ask AI about.
   - `classes.html:15` has no dates, duration, price, group size or booking link. "Book early" is vague, and there is no way to book.
   - `index.html:15` ("a wide range of loaves from heritage grains") is generic. Name the grains, the fermentation time and the bakery's story.

5. **`breads.html:16` uses `data-nosnippet` on the allergen text.** That keeps the allergen information out of search and AI snippets. If this is deliberate, leave it. Otherwise remove it, because users and assistants asking "is it vegan or nut-free?" will not get that answer from your page.

6. **`members/index.html` is both `noindex` (line 9) and `Disallow`ed in `robots.txt:3`.** Crawlers blocked by robots.txt can't read the `noindex`, so the URL can still appear in results as a bare link if something links to it. Fix: remove the `Disallow` line and keep `noindex`, or put the page behind a login. This is low priority, since the page has no content.

7. **No social or preview metadata.** There are no `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` or `twitter:card` tags in any `<head>`. Add them at `index.html:8` and in the other pages.

8. **Sitemap has no `<lastmod>`** (`sitemap.xml:3-5`). Add accurate dates so crawlers know when pages change.

9. **Minor items.**
   - `/img/loaves.jpg` (`index.html:16`) isn't in the repo, so check that it exists. Add `width` and `height` attributes.
   - Only the home page has an image. Add photos of the breads.
   - The pages share only a nav and have no footer or breadcrumb.
   - Consider a short `llms.txt` summarising the site. It is optional and not yet used much by search engines.
   - Pages end in `.html`. That works, but clean URLs would be tidier. If you change them, update the canonicals and sitemap together.

I haven't changed any files. I can apply items 1, 2, 7 and 8 now. Items 3 and 4 need real details from you: address, hours, loaf list and class info.
